# Clinical Indicators

This area groups the specific clinical quality indicators and metrics used to evaluate and improve healthcare outcomes within the corpus. It currently covers acute surgery, detailing the process and outcome metrics—such as timely antibiotic administration, preoperative optimization, and mortality rates—used by the Akut Kirurgi Databasen (AKDB) to monitor care for high-risk abdominal patients.

## Pages

- [[topics/clinical-indicators/acute-surgery/index|Acute Surgery]] — Core clinical quality indicators and foundational medical concepts used by the AKDB to monitor and improve care for acute high-risk abdominal surgery patients, including process metrics and mortality rates.
